snippet.title: MR DONALD: SAVE VATICAN - Demo announcement trailer
snippet.description: MR DONALD — an action shooter where you must save gamedev and America. Enter the Vatican and fight French cultists obsessed with “historical accuracy.” Make the Pope’s throne great again!
